mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production levels indicate robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate profit declines and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises while industrial production (INDPRO) falls, it indicates a stagflationary environment that erodes corporate margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (defined by three consecutive months of declining federal funds rate), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns as investors anticipate economic support and lower discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1600 thousand units indicates a contraction in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1600.

mechanism_narrative: Higher unemployment rates indicate a weakening labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance, which typically leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom (defined by housing starts above 1700 thousand units), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns as the real estate sector drives consumer confidence and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1700.
